text.text_excerpt: I cannot write a more enthusiastic review about my experience staying with Rita at the R&B Bed and Breakfast. So many things to comment on: 1. The house: How exquisite! What history! An amazing place to bring friends and rent out the entire place. 2. Rita: Wow! It's not possible to go more above and beyond than she did for my trip with my girlfriends. She was incredibly attentive and welcoming, more than generous with how she accommodated us. This enterprise is her love and she did more than expected to ensure we had an AMAZING weekend. 3. If you are visiting NOLA and want to be near all the fun stuff happening in French Quarter, STAY HERE. Do not even bother looking at other places. You'll inevitably come back to this place and book it anyway. And if you don't, you're truly missing out. If you still need convincing, go look up this place on TripAdvisor and see the perfect reviews. There just aren't enough reviews on here to do this place justice. First, the place. The house is apparently over 100 years old, but they've done a lot of renovations on the place to keep it clean, up-to-date, and with some modern fixings (bathoom, heating/cooling, etc.). Nawlins is my home & because Mylo Ranger is on tour & had never been to this magical city,of course,I wanted to show them the best time ever, that they'd carry dear in their hearts forever. My son,Barron,always knew his mom was cool,& after staying at the R&B B&B & meeting Miss Rita it's confirmed,not only with him but with all the band !
